name: Magda
source:
"I've atoned for my crimes. I was a model prisoner and now I'm straight."

Belongs to the "Black Hawk" street gang in a district full of immigrants. She was imprisoned for theft and arson but is now released, returning to the Black Hawks. She has a rough personality but has a strong sense of fellowship.
